payload.author: claude
payload.body: Delivered: RegionFailoverCoordinator tracks region health (healthy/draining/down) and deterministically promotes a key's home to the lowest-regionId healthy survivor when its home goes down/drains (same total/symmetric tie-break as FR-106/154, coordination-free). Writes re-route to the promoted home via the unchanged routeWrite path. Recovered region rejoins as an eligible target without reverting promotions (no flapping); zero-healthy left as-is. Ops docs: docs/multi-region-operations.md (health-checking, graceful-drain vs hard-outage, rejoin, and the LB/DNS glue: decoupled client->region geo affinity vs write->home routing planes, health-based LB failover). apps/server/src/cluster/region-failover.ts; tests region-failover.test.ts. Server gate green (1075 pass).
